patch_description: Replace all CZ gates with parametrized CRZ gates using a shared parameter `phi_shared`. This gives the optimizer direct control over entanglement angles while maintaining parameter economy (adding just 1 new parameter total). CRZ gates have been shown to converge faster than fixed CZ gates and allow the entangling strength to be tuned to the problem structure. The shared parameter across all CRZ gates preserves the linear entangling ladder structure while enabling adaptive entanglement.
